subject.title: fix(auth): bind OAuth and sessions to immutable identity

question: Should existing email-owned GitHub sessions and durable records be immediately rejected on upgrade, or should Crabbox provide a bounded migration or recovery path before enforcing immutable `github:<id>` ownership?
rationale: The patch intentionally changes the upgrade contract for existing authenticated users and durable owners; source-level tests can verify mechanics but cannot choose the acceptable access-loss and operator-remediation policy.

options.title: Add a bounded migration or recovery path
options.body: Preserve the immutable-ID target while allowing verified existing owners or administrators to migrate legacy email-owned records without silently transferring ownership.

options.title: Approve a fail-closed rollout
options.body: Accept immediate rejection of legacy email-owned records, with explicit deployment guidance for `CRABBOX_GITHUB_ADMIN_OWNERS`, affected users, and durable-record recreation.

recommendation.title: Add a bounded migration or recovery path
recommendation.body: Preserve the immutable-ID target while allowing verified existing owners or administrators to migrate legacy email-owned records without silently transferring ownership.

likelyOwner.reason: The author has documented the intended compatibility contract and can clarify the proposed rollout, though a repository owner should make the final product decision.
